_annotation.name: How It Works / Process Steps
_annotation.what: 3-step process showing how a customer gets started — choose business type, enter data, go live. Displayed on the homepage.
_annotation.why: Complexity kills conversions. If a visitor can't immediately understand 'how this works,' they'll leave. Three clear steps remove friction and make starting feel effortless.
_annotation.ai_popolates: Step titles and descriptions: Generated to match your business type. Steps are templated but copy is customized per industry (restaurant → menu setup, consulting → service catalog).
_annotation.your_input: Confirm your business type and which of your services are priority. We adjust the process steps accordingly.

title: Elegí tu tipo de negocio
desc: Restaurante, taller, bar, consultoría, tienda — tenemos plantillas para todos los rubros. Solo decinos el tuyo.

title: Completá tus datos
desc: Nombre, servicios, precios, horarios, fotos, info de contacto. Todo lo que vos ya sabés, lo cargás fácil.

title: ¡Listo! Tu página está online
desc: En minutos tenés tu página profesional, optimizada para móviles y lista para recibir clientes. Sin complicaciones.
